title: Vessel Safety Risk Assessment
description: Free Vessel Safety Risk Assessment template for maritime you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, before departure, approval & sign-off.
html:

DOCUMENT DETAILS

Hazards And Controls

HazardWho / what is at riskExisting controlsLSRiskAdditional controls / owner
Fire on boardCrew, vesselFire detection, fixed systems, drills, hot work permits
Collision or groundingCrew, vessel, en vironmentNavigation watch, passage plan, ECDIS and radar, COLREGS
Man overboardCrewLifejacket s, lifebuoys, safety lines, MOB drills
Enclosed space entryCrewPermit to enter, gas testing, v entilation , rescue plan
Heavy weather and loss of stabilityCrew, vesselWeather routeing, stability calculatio ns, securing cargo
Mooring and anchoring accidentsDeck crewSnap-back zones, trained crew, equipment inspection
FatigueCrewRest hours monitored, watch schedules

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Before Departure

☐ Safety equipment inspected: lifeboats, liferafts, EPIRB, fire fighting

☐ Muster list and emergency plans current; drills recorded

☐ Passage plan approved and weather reviewed

☐ Crew certificates valid and rest hours compliant

☐ Cargo secured and stability checked
